Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Fax Tone States

The value parameter of the telCAFaxToneMsg message (page 5-23) contains one of the following constants. 
enum {
   telFaxToneDetected      = 0,
   telFaxToneCleared       = 1
};
Constant descriptions
telFaxToneDetected
A fax tone has been detected.
telFaxToneCleared
A fax tone has stopped.
